A randomly generated region is created which is partition into polling stations. This process takes into consideration what is the population, how many parties there are, what percentage of the population votes for each party.


The gerrymandering is done based on the weights each party gets e.g. if there are 4 parties they could have the weights 0.1, 1, 0.2, 0.7 which favors the most the second party, then the fourth, then the third, then the first. The election system used is first past the post in each district.

The output given are two svg's and text in terminal. The first svg shows the starting map, the second svg shows the map at the end. Each svg shows how the districts are formed. The text in terminal shows what are the expected seats, and then the won seats before the gerrymander (using the districts shown by the first svg), and then the won seats after the gerrymander (using the districts shown by the second svg)

An example of the output in which we have a population of 1 million with 1 thousand polling stations which has 4 parties which have roughly 15%, 25%, 30%, 30% voting share and their weights are 0, 1, 0, 0 i.e. maximizing the seats won by the second party.

Text in terminal
```
-----EXPECTED SEATS-----
FOR PARTY 0 is expected to get 2.99994
FOR PARTY 1 is expected to get 5.00007
FOR PARTY 2 is expected to get 6
FOR PARTY 3 is expected to get 6
-----END OF EXPECTED SEATS-----
-----WON SEATS-----
FOR PARTY 0 they got 2
FOR PARTY 1 they got 5
FOR PARTY 2 they got 6
FOR PARTY 3 they got 7
-----END OF WON SEATS-----
-----WON SEATS-----
FOR PARTY 0 they got 0
FOR PARTY 1 they got 13
FOR PARTY 2 they got 1
FOR PARTY 3 they got 6
-----END OF WON SEATS-----
```
